notes.title: Version 50
notes.content:
Massive UI Overhaul
It took a lot of work, but we finally made it so you can use your mouse to navigate throughout the entirety of Beat Banger! Gone are the days of not being able to use your mouse to navigate the menu! We've also improved the way controllers work on menus.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/913b2346d231b3676527d9c2522e618d9d7f4927.jpg"]

We've also given the main menu a new look featuring Zoe. We'll soon be adding more characters to the main menu, and we hope to have more creative and interactive interfaces in the future!

We've also completely overhauled the hot menu to be more mouse-friendly and less intrusive. A few options from the old menu are missing, such as the glyph override control; however, we'll add them back shortly.


Rank and (S)EXP
Beat Banger now includes tracked experience value, which gives you a title for being the best Beat Banger around. This value unlocks things gradually throughout the game, as well as provides a mechanism for unlocking content in later updates, such as secret levels and character interactions that wouldn't be possible otherwise.

You can gain (S)EXP from unlocking achievements, playing official levels, and even from playing mods! Beating official levels ranges from 50 to 100, depending on difficulty. It shouldn't be too difficult to unlock everything quickly. We may add more ranks for higher XP values down the line.


Fan Art Gallery
We've added a fan art section to the In-Game Gallery to allow community members to show off the fantastic fan art they've made! The images in the gallery are just the beginning, as we plan to add more in future updates.

notes.title: Zoe Volume 2 is HERE!
notes.content:
ZOE IS HERE
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/2401cca3497526023e1655eb2a049698810baa97.jpg"]

It took a long time, but Zoe Volume Two is finally out. There's been a noticeable improvement in animation quality in this level compared to the previous ones, and you can expect more of the same quality for the rest of the levels in volume 2. As well as having a higher volume of animations per level.

Recent staffing changes have allowed us to get the artwork for levels done a bit faster than before, so we'll be tightening our deadlines to hit goals that were previously unreasonable for us to hit. 

After volume two is complete, we'll be revamping animations from some of the volume one levels as well as adding animations to levels that didn't receive enough love, such as Gale's level.


ARROW KEYS[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/782ca2696bc484393bfe7ed96427f9fdf987eb3e.jpg"]  
You can now use the arrow keys to play Beat Banger! We've updated every single chart to feel more directional and provide you with inputs based on the movement of the action happening in the animation. Of course, if you prefer, you can still switch back to using the letter keys, but note that all of the charts have been rewritten to feel more directionally influenced.


Future Levels
Despite how long it's taken us to get Zoe's level out, we've made a lot of internal changes that should help us get around the walls that usually lead to level delays.

notes.title: Version 45
notes.content:
Cutscene Editor (WIP)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/5ecf3d9f7653f2736c968e96014f6c12b1c6c992.jpg
The cutscene editor is now accessible through the level editor. It's still a work in progress, but you should be able to create cutscenes before and after your level. Drag and drop images and audio to make a shot for your cutscene (Currently, only .ogg works for audio, but I'm adding support for more now), And create characters by clicking the (+) button next to the character name dropdown on the top left! You can assign your character a specific color and reuse that asset throughout the cutscene.

Camera Zoom Controls (WIP)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/ae4d8e8a72ed67c289fd957492cfe489eda7af50.jpg
You can make your levels far more dynamic by adding camera zoom keyframes. It allows you to move the character's position on the screen to create more dynamic shots and emphasize the important "assets" of the characters in your mod. You can add a camera zoom keyframe by pressing `shift+a` on your keyboard in the timeline of the level editor. This is still a work-in-progress feature, so you may encounter a few bugs.

Collection Items (WIP)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/62010b8d429c342e00902645a67b9bab069c8c4c.jpg
The collection scene that previously did nothing now does something, sort of... None of the items are unlockable because they will be accessible through the Gachapon machine. The framework for adding items and the artwork for many of them have already been completed. So, when the Gachapon machine works, you can unlock many items in the collection scene!

notes.title: Beat Banger Mod Download Fix Patch
notes.content:
This is, by no means, a regular update, but since the bbooru.fun domain expired after we acquired their site; downloading mods from the old fetch URL no longer works. 

THE NEW MODS MENU IS CURRENTLY VERY BUGGY

We believe having a slightly buggy menu is better than having downloads that do not work at all, so for now, I'm pushing this patch. However, we'll quickly fix all of the small annoying bugs in the next regular update and make it a lot more intuitive to use. I'll also be updating tags and aliases to make it easier to find the mods you're looking for and a way to find mods by creators and by the title of the mod.

Included with the improved mod browser, we'll also be getting ready to implement the ability for mod creators to add cutscenes. This update will allow for full storytelling experiences and custom campaigns to be played and shared amongst players.

notes.title: Version 3.7 - Shop Update + Dawna Progress
notes.content:
Sorry for the wait. It's been a little tricky to get used to the new swing of things now that our art pipeline is different and with the addition of merchandise. It's been a journey figuring out how to time manage everything. But now we're steadily settling into a more stable workflow, and we should be able to get future updates out semi-monthly as planned.

This update is relatively small, but it paves the way for us to add some planned features, such as the Gachapon feature And the ability to remove Jasmine's clothes 😳

The Shop Has A New Look

The shop has been updated to be more compact and readable on the steam deck. We've reverted the category menu controls back to using the left and right arrows on your keyboard, and the Q and E keys will now change which section of the shop is focused. This change will allow you to access the ability to change Jasmine's outfit and will allow you to access the Gachapon system!

Jasmine's outfit variants are in the game files but are not unlockable yet. Expect an update on that in a few days. The Gachapon system will come later as it is more complex.

Dawna Progress

notes.title: Version 3.531
notes.content:
Hold Notes

You asked for it, and now it's here! The note type framework has been updated to include Hold and Bomb notes and simplified to include new note types in the future! These are also available to put in your mods using the in-game level editor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/0797452f0fab721ab2abd68ec643e3f72263eaf5.png

Level Editor Updates

The level editor has been updated to include the new note types. We've also added quality-of-life functionality, such as previewing your level from the editor's current timestamp. Testing your level will change the pause menu to include a "Return to editor" button, allowing you to switch between the editor and the preview easily! Some other small bug fixes are also included.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/9edaa745f5e3163309d905c5c5a27457a2823aa9.png

A Shift In Gears
The original Artist and Animator for Beat Banger, Komdog, will no longer be doing any drawn artwork or animation for the game. As we shift to new talent, please give a bit of time to get everyone trained and up to the quality standard and style that Beat Banger currently has. Dawna's Level is still being prioritized, and we plan to continue the game's story into volume 2.

notes.title: Version 3.48 - Achievements, Stats, and Visual Updates
notes.content:
Achievements and a bunch of other quality-of-life changes are here! They're still a work in progress, so bear with us as we work out all the bugs and kinks. 

Stat Tracking (Beta)
Beat Banger will start tracking stats like how many levels you've played to aid in unlocking achievements. These stats only start tracking your achievement progress when we add them to the game's code, So the number of levels you've beaten, for example, will only now start being recorded and stored in your saved data!

Mod Downloading (Beta)
You can now download mods from online! The best site to use for this is bbooru.fun. You can copy the download link of the mod you wish to download and paste it into the mod menu to download. Note that only zip files work with the built-in mod extractor, so check the link you've copied to ensure it's compatible. Dragging and dropping files into your mods folder still works. Use that to download any mods that aren't zip files.

Mod Exporting (Beta)
The level creator now allows you to export your completed mods as zip files! This feature will ensure you always have your mod correctly formatted for automatic downloads and drag-and-drop extraction! We'll soon add more level creation features that simplify modpack creation, so stay tuned for more updates!

We've added a lot more polish and visual improvements as well! We'll continue trying to make Beat Banger the best it can be!

notes.title: Version 3.455 - Save Data ID Patch
notes.content:
It looks like some people's saved data got borked. We found the source of the problem. TLDR Beat Banger was using the name of the current mod pack and the current level to try and locate the saved data; this meant that if you changed the name of your mod pack or your level, then it could not properly access the save data in your app data folder.

Mod packs and acts now use an md5 hash As a permanent fingerprint that your mod pack can use to identify its location in your saved data. So, long story short, you won't lose any more of your saved data if you leave the act ID and the level ID untouched. ✨

We've got a relatively sizable update this time around. It's more of a feature rather than a level update, but don't worry; Dawna's level will drop soon enough.

More Frequent Updates
Before we get into the patch notes, I want to make a quick announcement. We've decided to increase the amount of updates we push within a given timeframe. Nowwe'll be pushing updates semi-monthly, which means you'll get an updated version of Beat Banger with bug fixes and new features two times each month! These will happen at the beginning of every month and in the middle of every month. ✨

Level Creator (Beta)
Inside the extras menu is now an option to go to a level creator! This does most of the work required to set up a new mod. So, creating levels from scratch should be more accessible than ever. The level creator also allows you to drag and drop gifs, MP4s, and sprite sheets directly into the editor, cutting out the work of finding a program to painstakingly create a sprite sheet in the correct format at the correct size.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/21c63b13db6a7a76464f68e99218e53a07eff101.jpg

We'll eventually make it so Beat Banger can automatically zip mods you've created to allow other users to upload them to their clients quickly.

notes.title: Claire Is Here + Godot 4 Engine Update!
notes.content:
Claire's level is finally here. Some things will need to be hot-fixed over the next few days since the game is still effectively in Early Access. But Claire's level is ready to be played.

Aside from adding this new level, we've successfully re-coded the entire game from scratch in the BRAND NEW Godot 4 engine, a vastly improved version of the engine we had made Beat Banger in initially. This will bring various performance and quality-of-life improvements to make your experience more enjoyable.

We've also reworked how global menus function by creating a hot menu accessible anytime by hitting the Escape key on your keyboard or the start button on your respective controller.  This will allow you to edit your settings or access essential menus more easily across the game.

While incomplete, we have successfully implemented a level editor. At the moment, editing notes is the only functionality, but modders no longer need to download a separate tool to update their charts, and soon, they'll be able to create entire levels without ever having to leave the game.

Though this is a public release, We're still in Early Access, so there may be bugs here and there. Luckily, players now have the ability to report bugs quickly by pressing the "report a bug" button inside the game's hot menu, which will take you to our GitHub page, allowing us to, with your help, improve the quality of Beat Banger over time. 

Here are a few of the changes in this build:

notes.title: Lovense Support Is Here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018149/e6092e5f6de1a659f699c044fac4aaf15561c9c7.jpg
We finally got Lovense support integrated into Beat Banger. To access it, go into the options and click on "Lovense Mode" (Under the Game Section). There will be instructions for connecting your Lovense Devices in the pop-up menu. You'll need to download the Lovense Connect app and ensure your phone is connected to your computer's wifi network. 

Note: The Lovense API sends POST requests over your local network to communicate with your devices. You may experience a slight delay depending on your internet speed. To fix this, we'll also be working on integrating the Buttplug.io web socket protocol for more accurate and high-speed vibration communication in the future.

Black Screen Bug

A few users have been getting a black screen when starting the game. I haven't been able to reproduce this bug myself, but I have found a potential solution. It turns out this happens because the Godot Engine doesn't work well with Forced MSAA settings on the Nvidia graphics card. To solve this, I've changed the stretch mode that the game uses. So hopefully, this won't happen anymore, But if it does, please report it over on our Discord server: discord.gg/bunfan
